newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Coupons fall on Saudi two- to five-year bonds.
newsitem.headline: Coupons fall on Saudi two- to five-year bonds.

text.p: Coupons fell on two- to five-year Saudi government bonds worth 1.5 billion riyals, a banker said.
The annual coupon on two-year bonds dropped to 6.15 percent from 6.54 two weeks earlier and the rate on three-year bonds fell to 6.36 percent from 6.77.
The yield on four-year bonds was down at 6.51 percent from 6.93 and that on five-year paper was 6.71 percent from 7.13.
The rates are fixed at 30 basis points above the comparable U.S. note for two years, 35 points for three years, 40 points for four years and 50 points for five years.
The bonds are offered every two weeks on a Saturday.
